Weighted by the pool's parts: (0.10 x 0.349 + 0.055 x 0.13) / 0.155 = 0.2713. (2) The share of checkpoint-inhibitor starts a LAG-3 combination took after beating PD-1 alone: nivolumab plus relatlimab was 171 of 1,391 first-line checkpoint-inhibitor starts, 12.29%, among 1,772 US commercially insured metastatic melanoma patients starting first line in 2023 to 2025, with no significant rise over the period (Block MS et al., Target Oncol 2026;21:569-580, doi 10.1007/s11523-026-01235-y). 0.2713 x 0.1229 = 3.335%, with a multiple of 1.0: if the adjuvant trial wins, fianlimab takes the share of adjuvant immunotherapy that relatlimab took of first-line immunotherapy
